# Powerline Tattoo

> New England's #1 Custom Tattoo Studio — 706 Reservoir Avenue, Cranston, RI 02910

Powerline Tattoo is a private, appointment-only custom tattoo studio in Cranston, Rhode Island. Founded by Evan Olin, a RISD-trained illustrator, the studio is home to 8 award-winning tattoo artists specializing in realism, neo-traditional, American traditional, black and grey, color, illustrative, and portrait tattoos.

## Contact
- Phone: 401-369-7771
- Email: info@powerlinetattoo.com
- Address: 706 Reservoir Avenue, Cranston, RI 02910
- Instagram: @powerlinetattoo
- Website: https://powerlinetattoo.com
- Booking: By appointment only — no walk-ins

## Artists
- Evan Olin (@evanolintattoo) — Owner & Lead Artist, Realism & Color, RISD graduate, 15+ years
- Mikey Romasco (@mikeyffresh) — Black & Grey Realism & Portraiture, 15+ years
- Andy Large (@andylargetattoo) — Dynamic Realism & Surrealism, nature/space/portraits
- Andrey Vasilyev (@andreytattooing) — Color Neo-Traditional, bold lines & vibrant colors
- DJ Lebeau (@artworkby_dj) — Color Realism & Black & Grey, animal portraits/horror, 13+ years
- Dana Morse (@danamorsetattoos) — Versatile (Traditional to Realism), 18+ years
- Jake Meo (@jakemeotattoo) — Bold American Traditional, large-scale classics
- Chris Valencia (@cvalencia7) — Illustrative, Neo-Traditional & New School

## Services
- Custom tattoo design (no flash/pre-drawn)
- Free consultations
- Realism, portraits, neo-traditional, American traditional, black & grey, color, illustrative, new school, cover-ups
- Hospital-grade sterilization, single-use needles
- Rhode Island Board of Health certified

## Key Facts
- Location: Cranston, Rhode Island (serving Providence, Warwick, and all of New England)
- Style: Appointment-only private studio — no walk-ins
- Payment: Cash, Visa, Mastercard, Discover (4% card surcharge)
- Age requirement: 18+ with valid photo ID
- Touch-ups: 1 free within 4 months
- No piercing, no gift cards, no tattoo parties
